title: ZenCart Enterprise Architecture
shortDescription: Enterprise e-commerce backend architecture built with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.4.2, and Spring Security.
longDescription: ZenCart is a high-volume, enterprise-grade e-commerce backend architecture engineered by KNT. Designed for transactional reliability and clean domain boundaries, it features structured relational domain modeling, relational persistence through Spring Data JPA, and zero-compromise security layers built with Spring Security. The system architecture includes logical data models (logicalmodel.drawio) and layered enterprise patterns for product catalogs, cart management, and order processing workflows.
highlights: Engineered logical relational data model for high-integrity e-commerce catalog and checkout workflows
Implemented Spring Data JPA repositories with performance-tuned MySQL query integration
Configured robust Spring Security filter chains for multi-endpoint role protection
Adopted Lombok annotation processing to maintain clean, maintainable domain entities
challenges: Balancing relational entity integrity with high-throughput database query efficiency
Structuring authentication and role-based authorization for multi-endpoint protection
decisions: Selected Spring Boot 3.4.2 to leverage modern Java 17 runtime performance and language features
Separated domain models from persistence layer using JPA repository abstractions

title: sukuma Fleet Logistics
shortDescription: Dynamic transport and fleet management showcase platform built with Angular 20 standalone architecture.
longDescription: A high-performance modern web application engineered by KNT for Sukuma Fleet Services in Gauteng. Architected using Angular 20 with standalone components, CSS3 keyframe animations, and modular enterprise sections for services, corporate values, transport logistics overview, and interactive contact navigation.
highlights: Architected with Angular 20 standalone component paradigm without NgModule overhead
Built dynamic CSS scroll and keyframe animations for transport vehicle iconography
Implemented responsive modular layout covering company values, fleet services, and inquiry workflows
challenges: Delivering smooth 60fps CSS keyframe animations across diverse mobile viewports
Maintaining clean component isolation with strict design system styling tokens
decisions: Used Angular standalone components for streamlined bundle size and tree-shaking
Organized features into isolated domain directories (hero, services, values, contact)

title: Avatarun 3D WebGL Engine
shortDescription: Interactive 3D WebGL avatar lip-sync application with Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Vite.
longDescription: Avatarun is a cutting-edge interactive 3D WebGL platform developed by KNT, combining React Three Fiber, Three.js, and audio-driven lip synchronization via the Rhubarb Lip Sync engine. Built with Vite for rapid development and optimized asset pipelines, delivering realistic 3D avatar animation directly in modern web browsers.
highlights: Rendered real-time 3D humanoid avatar models within the browser canvas with zero plugin requirements
Integrated phoneme-to-viseme mapping via Rhubarb Lip Sync for realistic facial animation
Configured Leva dynamic debug controls for real-time 3D lighting and camera manipulation
challenges: Managing 3D asset memory consumption and smooth framerates in WebGL contexts
Synchronizing audio timing curves with morph target animation tracks
decisions: Adopted React Three Fiber declarative scene graph over imperative Three.js loops
Used Vite as the build bundler for rapid hot module replacement of 3D shaders

title: Nedbank Mobile Banking Suite
shortDescription: Native iOS digital banking interface clone developed in Swift with Xcode and Auto Layout.
longDescription: A native iOS application engineered by KNT in Swift and Xcode, replicating institutional digital banking interfaces. Emphasizes clean iOS Human Interface Guidelines, native navigation controllers, secure financial presentation patterns, and pixel-accurate component rendering.
highlights: Constructed native iOS layout adhering strictly to Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG)
Implemented structured banking account overview and transactional card UI
Maintained modular Xcode workspace structure for scalable view controllers
challenges: Replicating complex banking UI states across multiple iOS device form factors
Ensuring visual hierarchy while maintaining strict contrast for financial data
decisions: Built natively in Swift to maximize performance and iOS platform consistency
